_comment: The companion plugin's changelog, in the same shape as the app's
assets/changelog/changelog.json. Its newest entry is the plugin's version:
CMakeLists.txt reads it, and CI fails a release tag that doesn't match it.
Newest release FIRST. Every entry needs a `version` (bare semver, no
leading v), a `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and a `highlights` map of locale -> list
of one-line strings. `en` is required; other locales are optional.
Add the entry for a release BEFORE tagging it:

en: First release: a VST3 (and AU on macOS) plugin that pairs a DAW session with its project in DAW Project Manager.
Pre-listen capture: put it on the master bus and each playback pass is recorded as the project's preview song, without bouncing.
To-dos: see the project's to-dos while you work, tick them off and add new ones, optionally stamped with the playhead time.
Finds the project on its own from the DAW's window title or the app's launch, with a search to pick it by hand.
